title: apply_contract_context input
description: Input for `apply_contract_context`. Declares providers the analyzer cannot see into the federation's repos.yaml. Dry-run by default; `snapshot` must be `live`.

service.description: A declared service, or an implicit repo-id service.

key.description: Endpoint key in the shared grammar, e.g. `http:POST /chat/stream`.

source.description: Where the declaration came from. Free-form.

dry_run.description: When true (the default), return the YAML that would be written and touch nothing.
